rationale: To ensure that users cannot submit the form without filling in all mandatory fields.

From: it_lead@toolchain.com

Date: 2026-02-18 14:45
Subject: Registration consent flow must be revised before launch

Hi All,

During the latest compliance review, Legal raised a blocking concern regarding how consent is collected in the registration journey.

At the moment, the current approach appears to bundle multiple legal acknowledgements too closely. For launch readiness, users need to express consent to the contractual terms and the personal-data-related notice in a clearly distinguishable way. A single combined acknowledgement is not sufficient for this purpose.

Please adjust the registration flow so that these approvals are captured independently and can be demonstrated separately if needed during audit.

This is a release-blocking compliance item.

Best regards,

Dr. Arpad Jog
General Counsel

Subject: Registration consent flow must be revised before launch

Hi All,

During the latest compliance review, Legal raised a blocking concern regarding how consent is collected in the registration journey.

At the moment, the current approach appears to bundle multiple legal acknowledgements too closely. For launch readiness, users need to express consent to the contractual terms and the personal-data-related notice in a clearly distinguishable way. A single combined acknowledgement is not sufficient for this purpose.

Hi All,

At the moment, the current approach appears to bundle multiple legal acknowledgements too closely. For launch readiness, users need to express consent to the contractual terms and the personal-data-related notice in a clearly distinguishable way. A single combined acknowledgement is not sufficient for this purpose.

Please adjust the registration flow so that these approvals are captured independently and can be demonstrated separately if needed during audit.

This is a release-blocking compliance item.

Best regards,

Dr. Arpad Jog
General Counsel

Hi All,

During the latest compliance review, Legal raised a blocking concern regarding how consent is collected in the registration journey.

At the moment, the current approach appears to bundle multiple legal acknowledgements too closely. For launch readiness, users need to express consent to the contractual terms and the personal-data-related notice in a clearly distinguishable way. A single combined acknowledgement is not sufficient for this purpose.

Please adjust the registration flow so that these approvals are captured independently and can be demonstrated separately if needed during audit.

This is a release-blocking compliance item.

Subject: Registration consent flow must be revised before launch

Hi All,

During the latest compliance review, Legal raised a blocking concern regarding how consent is collected in the registration journey.

At the moment, the current approach appears to bundle multiple legal acknowledgements too closely. For launch readiness, users need to express consent to the contractual terms and the personal-data-related notice in a clearly distinguishable way. A single combined acknowledgement is not sufficient for this purpose.

Please adjust the registration flow so that these approvals are captured independently and can be demonstrated separately if needed during audit.

This is a release-blocking compliance item.

Best regards,

Dr. Arpad Jog
General Counsel

This is a release-blocking compliance item.

# Description: User account registration and lifecycle management
# Status: Effective (v1.0)

## 1 User account registration and lifecycle management

## 1.1 User registration and account activation
## 1.1.1 The user must register in order to access the platform.
## 1.1.2. During registration, the system shall require the user to provide the following mandatory information: first name, last name, phone number, email address

title: Duplicate email registration displays generic message

Feature: Duplicate Email Registration
  Scenario: User attempts to register with an already-registered email
    Given an existing user account with email "existing@example.com"
    When a new user attempts to register with email "existing@example.com"
    And fills in all other mandatory fields correctly

During the latest compliance review, Legal raised a blocking concern regarding how consent is collected in the registration journey.

At the moment, the current approach appears to bundle multiple legal acknowledgements too closely. For launch readiness, users need to express consent to the contractual terms and the personal-data-related notice in a clearly distinguishable way. A single combined acknowledgement is not sufficient for this purpose.

Please adjust the registration flow so that these approvals are captured independently and can be demonstrated separately if needed during audit.

This is a release-blocking compliance item.

Best regards,

Dr. Arpad Jog
General Counsel

During the latest compliance review, Legal raised a blocking concern regarding how consent is collected in the registration journey.

At the moment, the current approach appears to bundle multiple legal acknowledgements too closely. For launch readiness, users need to express consent to the contractual terms and the personal-data-related notice in a clearly distinguishable way. Please adjust the registration flow so that these approvals are captured independently and can be demonstrated separately if needed during audit.

This is a release-blocking compliance item.

Best regards,

Dr. Arpad Jog
General Counsel

Hi All,

During the latest compliance review, Legal raised a blocking concern regarding how consent is collected in the registration journey.

title: Generic message prevents email enumeration on duplicate registration
gherkin:
Feature: Email Enumeration Prevention
  Scenario: System displays generic message for existing email addresses
    Given a user has already registered with email "existing@example.com"
    When a new user attempts to register with the same email "existing@example.com"
    And fills in all other mandatory fields
    And checks the Terms and Conditions checkbox
    And clicks the Submit button
    Then the system should display the message "If this email is valid, a message has been sent to it"
    And the message should NOT indicate whether the email already exists
    And no new account should be created
rationale: Ensures the system prevents email enumeration attacks by displaying a generic message instead of revealing whether an email is already registered.

This is a release-blocking compliance item.

Subject: Registration consent flow must be revised before launch

Hi All,

During the latest compliance review, Legal raised a blocking concern regarding how consent is collected in the registration journey.

At the moment, the current approach appears to bundle multiple legal acknowledgements too closely. For launch readiness, users need to express consent to the contractual terms and the personal-data-related notice in a clearly distinguishable way. A single combined acknowledgement is not sufficient for this purpose.

Please adjust the registration flow so that these approvals are captured independently and can be demonstrated separately if needed during audit.

This is a release-blocking compliance item.

Best regards,

Dr. Arpad Jog
General Counsel

Subject: Registration consent flow must be revised before launch

Hi All,

During the latest compliance review, Legal raised a blocking concern regarding how consent is collected in the registration journey.

At the moment, the current approach appears to bundle multiple legal acknowledgements too closely. For launch readiness, users need to express consent to the contractual terms and the personal-data-related notice in a clearly distinguishable way. A single combined acknowledgement is not sufficient for this purpose.
